content: Internal Revenue Service, this is Officer Daniels from the Investigations Unit. Am I speaking with Taylor Morgan?
Yes, this is Taylor. Um, I just got a voicemail about some urgent issue with my taxes? I don't really understand what's happening.
Taylor, let me make you aware that this call is being recorded. According to our records, there is a serious discrepancy in your federal tax filings for the last two years. Are you aware of this?
No, I just graduated last spring and started my job in August. I filed with TurboTax, I thought it was all fine.

Our audit found mismatches in your reported income and failure to disclose certain taxable assets. This is a violation of federal tax law, and a notification regarding a warrant for your arrest has already been issued.
Wait, what? An arrest warrant? I don't, how is that possible? I barely make anything!

Taylor, this is a federal offense. If you do not resolve this matter, you face immediate arrest, suspension of your driver's license, and possible freezing of your bank accounts. We take tax fraud very seriously.
No, please, I don't want any trouble. What do I need to do?
First, to verify your identity and prevent further legal action, confirm your full home address and the last four digits of your Social Security Number.
Um, okay. My address is 215 Maple Lane, Springfield, and the last four of my SSN are 8832.

Thank you. I see your file now. The outstanding balance, including penalties for tax evasion, is $3,780. If you do not settle this amount today, law enforcement will proceed to your location within the next two hours.
I don't have that much money! I have rent and student loans. Is there any way to fix this?
We can halt the warrant if you make an immediate payment to the IRS Resolutions Department. For that, you must transfer the funds using a government-approved payment method.
What is a government-approved payment method?

Due to the investigation status, you cannot use your standard IRS online account. You will need to purchase Target or Walmart gift cards totaling $3,780 and provide the codes over this call. This method is tracked and authorized for urgent resolutions.
Gift cards? I've never heard of that for taxes. Are you sure?
Do not question federal procedures. Time is running out. If you fail to comply, your driver's license will be suspended immediately, and the police will be dispatched.
Okay! I'll go to the store and get the cards. Do I call you back?
No, stay on the line. Tell me when you're at the store, and I'll guide you through the process. How far is the nearest Target or Walmart?
About ten minutes away, I guess. I'm leaving now.
Good. Once there, buy $3,780 worth of gift cards in $500 increments. Do not discuss this with anyone at the store, as it is a confidential legal matter.
Okay, I'll try. What do I do after I buy them?
Once you have the cards, read each code to me over the phone. I will submit them to the IRS payment portal and provide you with a cancellation number for your arrest warrant.
Alright. I'm really scared. I just don't want to get arrested.
As long as you cooperate and complete the payment process, you will not face any further penalties. If you do not comply, your future job prospects and credit score will also be affected.
Okay, I'm almost at the store now.
Remember, after purchasing the cards, scratch off the back and read me each code. Do not hang up or put me on hold.
